rows.name: n_crosslinks
rows.description: Number of NC1/7S crosslink bonds (total bonds minus intra-rod); confirms the network assembles.

rows.name: sigma_inplane
rows.description: Bond-virial in-plane stress = -0.5*(pxx+pyy) scaled by volume; the rheology readout.

rows.name: relaxation_time_lj
rows.description: Exponential stress-relaxation time tau fit from the stress trace; NaN when below the noise floor.

rows.name: elastic_modulus_lj
rows.description: Tangent modulus of the network under growth loading (reduced units).
